patterns.what_worked: Two ROGUE scenarios registered through the shared harness with nil-state unscored paths; grade pins cover S/A/B/C/D plus both F mirrors and the nil-tick/nil-swing cases; options copy updated without touching any toggle key or behavior.
patterns.what_was_hard: Keeping the energy tick model honest: the marker is one latency before the 2 s tick, so the drill grades spend-start fractions without pretending to read live energy. Late SS-window F grades come from the band fallback, so the window-end guard is defensive rather than separately mutation-provable.
patterns.skill_gap: None material; mutation proof for the late SS window edge is indirect (fallback F) rather than a distinct guard.
